therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: angiotensin II type 1 receptor and neprilysin
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: angiotensin receptor blockade and neprilysin inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: neurohormonal modulation reducing cardiac wall stress and natriuretic peptide degradation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with chronic heart failure and preserved left-ventricular ejection fraction (HFpEF)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: change from baseline in NT-proBNP at 12 weeks (geometric mean ratio)

results.effect_size: LCZ696 ratio 0.83 (95% CI 0.68–1.01) vs valsartan ratio 1.08 (95% CI 0.89–1.32) at 12 weeks
results.target_engagement_evidence: cGMP ratio at 36 weeks: LCZ696 0.90 vs valsartan 0.85; BNP ratio at 36 weeks: LCZ696 1.14 vs valsartan 0.95
biomarker_changes: NT-proBNP ratio at 36 weeks: LCZ696 0.78 vs valsartan 0.92
BNP ratio at 36 weeks: LCZ696 1.14 vs valsartan 0.95
cGMP ratio at 36 weeks: LCZ696 0.90 vs valsartan 0.85
LV mass index change: LCZ696 -3.95 g/m² vs valsartan -1.94 g/m²
Left atrial volume index change: LCZ696 -4.02 ml/m² vs valsartan -0.88 ml/m²
E/e' ratio change: LCZ696 -1.18 vs valsartan -0.75
eGFR change: LCZ696 -3.68 vs valsartan -7.14 mL/min/1.73m²
Sitting SBP change: LCZ696 -7.47 mmHg vs valsartan -2.18 mmHg
Sitting DBP change: LCZ696 -5.28 mmHg vs valsartan -1.39 mmHg
subgroup_findings: Clinical composite improved: LCZ696 41.7% vs valsartan 32.8%
NYHA Class I at week 36: LCZ696 12.6% vs valsartan 7.2%
Left atrial volume change: LCZ696 -8.08 ml vs valsartan -2.38 ml
LV mass change: LCZ696 -11.26 g vs valsartan -8.00 g
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were generally balanced between arms
Cardiac failure SAEs: LCZ696 3/149 vs valsartan 2/152
Cardiac failure acute SAEs: LCZ696 1/149 vs valsartan 3/152
Unstable angina SAEs: LCZ696 3/149 vs valsartan 1/152
